svg.title: How infographic works
svg.desc: Claude writes a YAML spec; the CLI draws, checks and reports until the gate passes. Claude never edits the SVG: every finding names a spec target and is fixed in the spec. Critique of the storyboard is folded into the build rounds. Browser verification is run by verify.mjs (Playwright), not yet by the CLI itself. The gate and build count reset once the result is delivered. 1. Request: a one-line request; Claude designs the story. 2. Findings: findings name spec targets; Claude fixes the spec. 3. Gate passes: static gate passes and a storyboard comes back. 4. Browser check: each engine shows what the timeline says. 5. Delivered: light and dark SVGs plus a README embed.
